Name: Example: the card thief
Notes: An example to copy (on no creature). When a player heals, it keeps heals out of that player's next 2 hands and puts a Fire Cat in its own. At the start it sets its pips to 3 a round (half of them power pips) for 3 rounds. Under half health, once: it shuffles everyone's hands back into their decks, counts as Ice for 3 rounds (its boosts and resists too), and casts again after everyone for 2 rounds.
